name: @limio/ot-help-me-choose
description: OpenText Business Network 'Help me choose' page: hero that opens the Limio AI assistant, what the assistant asks, the plans it chooses between (prices follow the region picked in ot-header) and an existing-customer band. Pair it with limio-chat-side-panel so the assistant docks beside the page.

limioProps.label: Headline
limioProps.default: Not sure which plan fits? Ask our assistant.

limioProps.label: Subheadline
limioProps.default: Tell it how you trade today and who is asking you for EDI. In three or four questions it recommends B2B Integration Essentials, Trading Grid Foundation or Enterprise, with the price and a link to build your plan.

default.title: How you work today
default.body: Orders and invoices in an ERP such as NetSuite, SAP or Dynamics, or keyed by hand.

default.title: Who wants EDI from you
default.body: Walmart, Target, Tesco… the number of trading partners sets the plan size.

default.title: How much you trade
default.body: Roughly how many orders a month, so the plan has the right document allowance.

default.title: Who sets it up
default.body: Do it yourself, or have an OpenText specialist run the setup with you.

key.label: Price key (starter | plus | f5 | f10 | enterprise)

default.title: Starter
default.body: No ERP. Web portal, 2 trading partners, 1,000 documents a month.

default.title: Plus
default.body: No ERP. Web portal, 5 trading partners, 5,000 documents a month.

default.title: Foundation 5
default.body: Your ERP connected. 5 trading partners, 10,000 documents a month.

default.title: Foundation 10
default.body: Your ERP connected. 10 trading partners, 25,000 documents a month.

default.title: Enterprise
default.body: More than 15 partners, high volume or custom integrations.

limioProps.label: Existing customer body
limioProps.default: Tell the assistant what you need. It opens a support case with the Business Network team, with your conversation attached, so you never explain twice.
